{{Otheruses|Naboo}}
The '''Naboo message exchange''' was an online forum on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].<ref name="Hnn 531 45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_4.html|Stark Veterans Blast Amidala}}</ref>

==History==
People could use the exchange to post comments on news of the day.
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] posted a message on the message exchange justifying her controversial statements made during a Peace Rally on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="Hnn 531 45" />
